00-start-here.topic:
Workspace guide for core contributors and NGO staff.

核心贡献者与 NGO 管理人员的工作区指南。
00-start-here.description:
Find channels, working practices and team responsibilities. Ask where work belongs and link useful guidance. Keep instructions current and note who owns each process.

查找频道、工作规范与团队分工，询问事项归属并分享实用指引。及时更新说明，注明各流程负责人。

announcements.topic:
Internal announcements, deadlines and confirmed meetings.

内部公告、截止日期与已确认的会议。
announcements.description:
Post confirmed team updates: what changed, affected people, action, deadline and contact. Link source documents; discuss follow-up in ops-daily or the project thread.

发布已确认的团队通知，写明变化、影响对象、所需行动、期限及联系人。附来源文档，后续讨论放在 ops-daily 或相关项目线程。

ops-daily.topic:
Daily coordination: priorities, owners, blockers and handovers.

日常协作：优先事项、负责人、阻碍与交接。
ops-daily.description:
Coordinate routine operations and administration. State the task, owner, due date and help needed. Use one thread per issue; record the outcome and next step. Raise blockers early.

协调日常运营与行政事务，写明任务、负责人、期限及所需协助。每件事使用独立线程，补充处理结果与下一步，尽早提出阻碍。

ops-projects.topic:
Project and event delivery: plans, milestones and outcomes.

项目与活动执行：计划、里程碑与成果。
ops-projects.description:
Coordinate projects and events: scope, milestones, owners, blockers and outcomes. Use a thread per project. Link current plans and approval records; confirm changes with the owner.

协调项目与活动执行，在项目线程内更新范围、里程碑、分工、阻碍与成果。附最新版计划及相关批准记录，变更与负责人确认。

ops-proposals.topic:
Prepare proposals, review drafts and resolve open questions.

准备提案、审阅草稿与解决待确认问题。
ops-proposals.description:
Draft goals, owner, plan, budget, timeline and expected outcomes. Use a thread per proposal; label versions and open questions. Track submission and approval status separately.

提案写明目标、负责人、计划、预算、时间线及预期成果。每份提案独立线程，注明版本与待确认问题，分别记录提交和审批状态。

ops-alerts.topic:
Operational incidents: impact, response and recovery.

运营事件：影响、响应与恢复。
ops-alerts.description:
Report impact, start time, urgency, owner and next action. Update the incident thread and confirm recovery. Sanitize evidence; never post secrets or personal data.

报告需要处理的问题：影响、开始时间、紧急程度、负责人及下一步。在事件线程持续更新并确认恢复。证据先脱敏，不发布密钥或个人隐私。

board-discussion.topic:
Board agendas, proposal review and deliberation.

董事会议程、提案审阅与讨论。
board-discussion.description:
Prepare Board agendas, review proposals and resolve questions. Use a thread per item; link current documents and note open issues. Declare conflicts and respect confidentiality.

准备董事会议程、审阅提案与解答问题。每项议题独立线程，附最新材料并记录待决事项。主动说明利益冲突，遵守保密要求。

board-votes.topic:
Board voting notices, ballot instructions and verified results.

董事会投票通知、投票指引与核实后的结果。
board-votes.description:
State the proposal version, eligible voters, voting method, rules and deadline with timezone. Keep questions in the vote thread; link verified results. Emoji reactions are not ballots.

每轮写明提案版本、投票资格、投票方式、规则及含时区的期限。答疑集中在该轮线程，附核实后的结果；表情反应不计作选票。

board-decisions.topic:
Confirmed Board decisions and follow-up actions.

已确认的董事会决定与后续行动。
board-decisions.description:
Record confirmed decisions: ID, date, proposal version and source. State owners, actions and deadlines; track follow-up in a thread. Link official records and label corrections.

记录已确认决定的编号、日期、提案版本与来源。写明负责人、行动及期限，在线程跟进。附正式记录，修正内容需明确标注。

finance-review.topic:
Budget, funding requests and financial review.

预算、资金申请与财务审阅。
finance-review.description:
Review budgets, funding requests and available funds. Note amounts, assumptions, source dates and questions. Restrict access to supporting records; omit bank details and credentials.

审阅预算、资金申请与可用资金，注明金额、假设、来源日期及待确认问题。佐证材料设置适当访问权限，不在聊天中发布银行信息或凭据。

social.topic:
Team introductions, informal conversation and shared interests.

团队介绍、轻松交流与兴趣分享。
social.description:
Meet teammates, share interests and celebrate contributions. Participation is optional. Respect differences and boundaries; no harassment or personal attacks. Coordinate work in ops-daily.

认识伙伴、分享兴趣与肯定贡献，自愿参与。尊重不同观点与个人边界，不骚扰或人身攻击；工作协作请到 ops-daily。

new-channel.topic:
Team questions and initial coordination.

团队问询与初步协调。
new-channel.description:
Ask questions or find the right owner. Give context and the help needed; follow up in a thread. Move ongoing work to the relevant operations channel and link the discussion.

提出一般问题或寻找事项负责人，说明背景与所需帮助，在线程跟进。持续性工作移至相应运营频道，并附上讨论链接。

rein-agent-test.topic:
Nori testing: scenarios, reproductions and results.

Nori 测试：场景、复现步骤与结果。
rein-agent-test.description:
Test Nori with synthetic cases. Use a thread per case; record steps, expected and actual results. Omit secrets and personal data. Test output is not an operational record.

使用明确标注的场景与合成数据测试 Nori。每个用例独立线程，记录步骤、预期、实际表现及结果。移除凭据与个人数据，测试输出不作正式业务记录。

rein-board-test.topic:
Governance workflow tests using synthetic proposals and votes.

使用合成提案与选票测试治理流程。
rein-board-test.description:
Test proposal review and voting with labeled synthetic cases. Use a thread per case; record roles, rules, steps, expected results and defects. Test outcomes are not Board decisions.

使用明确标注的合成用例演练提案审阅与投票。每例独立线程，记录角色、规则、步骤、预期结果与缺陷。测试选票及结果不作正式董事会决定。
